[Intro]
[G]

[G]Let's find out just how far I’ll
go
To look like someone you should
know Maybe I'd

You saw my number and my
number wasn’t good enough I'll

[F]have to

[Verse 2]
[G]How am I meant to stay on
track

Oh , I'll
[F]work a little harder But
[C]walk a little less

proud
That I grit my teeth, and
